summary: End-to-end test of the new /admin/staking module (P1-3 Feb 2026). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering auth gating (401 anon), CMS treasury (200 with USDC≈31.25 / ARSa≈100100), /cms/wallets (200 with 13 items including seeded qa-staking-module@prosper.foundation → GDE4FZ...ES6NR), /cms/cashin idempotent (reused=true, same wallet returned for end modality), 422 on invalid modality/missing prosperId, staking-sync status+run, stakings list with filters, and regression on /admin/prosper/treasury after adapter migration to /api/v1/cliente/*. Frontend: sidebar item nav-admin_staking navigates to /admin/staking, admin-staking-page renders, all 4 treasury widgets show real values (USDC 31,25 / ARSa 100.100 / XLM 0,00 / sync widget with 'cada 5 min, última: 8:56 p.m. · 10 procesados'), Sincronizar button executes POST /staking-sync/run successfully, all 3 tabs (Stakings/Wallets CMS/Nueva solicitud) navigate correctly, staking-table shows real rows (propio/externo badges, stellar.expert hash links), filters scope/asset/status refresh list to '1 stakings' for ours+usdc+active, wallets tab shows 13 wallets, client-side search filters to 1 hit for 'qa-staking-module', cashin form submit with 'qa-staking-module@prosper.foundation' + modality 'end' returns exact seeded wallet GDE4FZC7JP443JBYEB4MTTXOMZIFOA6W5E6LOL3Y6SYSW6LOLYAES6NR displayed in staking-cashin-address. Regression /admin/prosper/inversiones loads treasury widget correctly.

issues: Sonner toast on Sincronizar success was not detected by test selector [data-sonner-toast] — the widget updates correctly so functionally fine, but toast may render into a portal or dismiss too fast to be user-visible. Low priority — verify toast lifetime/portal target if user reports missing feedback.

critical_code_review_comments: phase22_admin_yield.py at ~740 lines — still under the 700-line hint but growing; consider extracting the CMS-passthrough endpoints (treasury/stakings/staking-sync/cms wallets/cms cashin) into a dedicated router file (phase_p1_cms_staking.py) for maintainability.
GET /admin/prosper/cms/wallets forwards the raw CMS payload including a 'raw' key — good for debugging but may leak partner-side fields. Consider stripping in production mode.

Frontend page.tsx (~540 lines) is a single file with 3 tab components + widgets. Fine for now but could be split into components/staking/{TreasuryAndSync,StakingsTab,WalletsTab,NewCashinTab}.tsx if it keeps growing.
